autoDolaSpreadRegime.interpretation: Real Tokemak autopool deposit/redeem vs convertToAssets spread, symmetric per leg, stepwise and state/oracle-driven (not rounding, not a schedule). Run-33's fork block sat 82 blocks before the up-step. The 2-bps round-trip gate was breached for ~6,769 blocks (~22.5 h).

unintendedEffects.effect: None new in state. The 087 delta only reorders Phase 7 pause-state txs; the 20-account write set is unchanged from run-33.

Go/no-go of the Phase 6 per-user bound flips with autoDOLA's stepwise spread regime; because every require runs only in forge's local pass, a regime step between the local pass and the Phase 6 txs landing produces an on-chain migration above the stated 2-bps bound that only :verify's live-balance aggregate detects (maskable by ~0.009 DOLA of organic V2 stake).
